title: Resume Marker
summary: Remembers where a reader stopped in a long feed or doc and offers a jump back, without moving the page on its own.
description: Saves the item a reader rested on (after a short delay) to localStorage, marks it "You were here" on return, and offers a jump there and back instead of scrolling the page by itself.
catches: The item the reader rested on, saved only after saveDelay so a quick flick isn't stored
Their place on return, shown as a marker
A jump to it and a jump back, never an automatic scroll
Stale or malformed saved positions, ignored after maxAge
limits: Stored in localStorage per device and browser; it does not sync
Needs stable item keys; reordered or removed items lose the marker
a11y: Marker is a role=separator with an aria-label
Jump and back move focus to the target item (tabIndex=-1) without an extra scroll jump
Smooth scrolling is skipped under reduced motion
Jump pill sits in a polite live region; dismiss has an aria-label
stops: Lost my place in a long feed
